name: Madriu-Perafita-Claror Valley
description: Tucked into the southeast corner of Andorra, this glacier-carved valley covers about 9% of the tiny country. Craggy cliffs, high meadows and steep forests surround stone-walled summer huts, terraced fields and old stone tracks. Shepherds have worked here for thousands of years, and some land is still owned communally under a system dating to the 13th century.
